verses.text: Tzin xajanej Jehová, yujto ix yab' in lesal ayik ix in tewi t'ay.
Yujto ix yab' tas ix in k'an t'ay, yuj chi' ol wal in b'a t'ay yakb'an pitzan hinto.
Ijan wal ix in yamchaj yuj chamel. Ix ja syaelal chamel t'ayin. Ha ilk'olal yet' yaelal ix jawi t'a wib'anh.
Ichato chi' ix walan in b'a t'a Jehová. Ix in tewi t'ay yik syak'an b'oxok in k'ool.
Ha Jehová, tojol toni, tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayonh. Ha ko Diosal, yelxo wal te niwan swach'k'olal.
Ha stanhwan heb' emnakil yeq'ui. Ayik toxo ix el wip, a ix in kolani.
Ayxo in junk'olal tiknaik swab'i, yujto a Jehová wach' ix yutej sk'ol t'ayin.
Maj in scha chamlaj, ix in skol t'a in kusk'olal, maj in schalaj telwok.
Yakb'an pitzan hinto ol in k'anab'ajej.
Ix wak'och Jehová yipok in k'ool, t'a skal in niwan yaelal ix walani: Te ya ayin, xin chi.
Manhxo animaok waj swab'i, yuj chi' ix wala' to masanil heb' anima, max yal-laj kak'anoch tas syal heb' yipok ko k'ool.
¿Tas ol wutej wak'an spak masanil swach'k'olal Jehová ix yak' t'ayin?
Ol wik'kot wino ofrendail t'ay yuj wak'an yuj diosal t'ay, yujto ix in skolo'.
Ha t'a yichanh masanil schonhab' ol wak'elk'och tas ix wal t'ay.
Te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh Jehová ayik scham junok mach yikxo.
Mamin Jehová, a in ton tik, a chekab' in. Ha ach ix in a koleli, yuj chi' libre in tiknaik.
Ol wak' in silab' yuj ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach yuj spakok a wach'k'olal. Ol wal in b'a t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak'elk'och in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh masanil heb' a chonhab',
t'a yamaq'uil a templo t'a snanhal chonhab' Jerusalén. Skal wach' lolonel t'ayach Jehová.
